headline: Design review of Lifebridge Main Campus project with 53 affordable homes and 70-bed shelter, plus other building projects.
summary: The agenda covers design review of the Lifebridge Main Campus, a two-family home at 16 Bridge Street, and a car wash on Highland Avenue. It also lists several small sign, window, and painting projects.

City Hall Annex • 98 Washington Street • Salem, Massachusetts 01970 • (978) 619-5685 
Page 1 of 2 
 
Design Review Board  
 
REVISED 
 
Meeting Agenda 
Wednesday, October 28, 2026 
6:00 pm 
 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Design Review Board will be held on Wednesday,  October 28, 2026, at 6:00 
p.m. via remote participation  pursuant to Section 30A of Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021, as amended by  Section 40 of 
Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023, and further amended by Section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025, the City is authorized 
to conduct remote meetings of its public bodies through June 30, 2027. 
 
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings in real time, via technological 
means. If we are unable to do so on matters not requiring a public hearing, we will post on the City of Salem’s website an 
audio or video recording, transcript, or other comprehensive record of proceedings as soon as possible after the meeting. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely in the meeting via a remote participation platform called Zoom. Members of the 
public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to attend this meeting may access the remote participation 
meeting through any one of the following ways: 
 
• Go to the website link 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84298788620?pwd=VElMWmQ0Sm5rN0dBNnYwMlJMc1UyQT09 or 
• Go to the website link www.zoom.us/join and enter meeting ID # 842 9878 8620 and Passcode 032989; or 
• Dial toll-free phone number 877-853-5257. When prompted, enter meeting ID # 842 9878 8620. Those 
only dialing in will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting but can follow along with the 
project materials available for download at: DRB Meeting Materials. 
 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments if they wish to do so, 
during the portion of the meeting designated for public comment. If you would like to make a comment, please 
use the ‘Raise Hand’ feature; if you are participating via phone, press *9 to raise your hand.  The Chair of the 
Board, with the assistance of City Staff, will provide all participants who have raised their hands with an 
opportunity to speak.  
 
 
Roll Call 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Signs in the Urban Renewal Area 
1. 231-251 Washington Street: Levana Group Leasing Signage 
 
Projects in the Urban Renewal Area   
1. 6 Front Street: Small Project Review – Replacement of 34 windows on the second and third floors of the 
property. Request to continue to the next DRB meeting. 
Joseph Badowski Elizabeth Murray 
Paul Durand, Chair Marc Perras 
Daniel Estes Sarah Tarbet 
Catherine Miller
Page 2 of 2 
 
2. 194 Essex Street, Unit 171, World of Wizardry: Small Project Review - Facade trim painting at World of 
Wizardry. 
3. 211 Bridge Street: Small Project Review – Restoration of seven windows on the southern facade.  
4. 24 Congress Street: Small Project Review – Facade painting, installation of tile trim, and new entry doors for 
Mexizol.   
 
Projects Outside of the Urban Renewal Area 
1. 56 Margin Street, 54 Margin Street, 7 High Street, 20 Endicott Street, and 24 Endicott Street: Smart Growth 
Overlay District - Design review of the proposed project at Lifebridge Main Campus. The applicant proposes the 
demolition of the buildings at 24 Endicott Street and 56 Margin Street, the adaptive reuse of 54 Margin Street, 
and the preservation of the facade of 20 Endicott Street to accommodate for a 22,806 square foot building 
comprised of 53 affordable homes, a shelter with 70 beds, and supportive programming space along with other 
site improvements. Thirteen parking spaces are proposed on site. 
2. 16 Bridge Street: Bridge Street Neck Overlay District – Design review of a proposed two-family residential 
building.  
3. 370 376 Highland Avenue, 378 380 Highland Avenue, and 382 Highland Avenue: Entrance Corridor Overlay 
District – Design review of proposed car wash facility. 
 
New/Old Business 
1. Approval of Minutes:  
a. September 9, 2026 
b. September 23, 2026 
2. Staff Updates 
 
Upcoming Meetings 
1. SRA: November 4 – Note that this date is one week earlier than normal due to Veterans Day. 
2. DRB: November 18 – Note that this date is one week earlier than normal due to Thanksgiving. 
 
Adjournment 
 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A §18-25 and City Ordinance Sections 2-028 through 2-2033. 
 
Persons requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign language interpreter, an assistive listening 
device, or print material in digital format or a reasonable modification in programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the 
City of Salem ADA Coordinator as soon as possible and no less than 2 business days before the meeting, program, or event.
